state_labor_quarterly.csv.source: FRED fredgraph CSV (no-key mirror of BLS LAUS {ST}UR / CES {ST}NA), quarterly means

crosswalk: STATE_TO_DISTRICT primary mapping (population-majority for 14 split states)
shock: AR(2) innovation of quarterly district BBUI, z-scored within district (derive_innovation_shock)
estimator: panel_lp_dk: two-way FE + Driscoll-Kraay SE, n_lags=4, horizons 0-12
band: sup-t (Montiel Olea & Plagborg-Møller 2019 JAE, Alg. 2) on 300 district-cluster bootstrap draws
